questions.stem_text: Describe the theory of Stern (1956) in the nature-nurture controversy.
Operant extinction would NOT be the treatment-of-choice when:

options.A: the behavior has been reinforced on a continuous schedule.
options.B: the behavior is not causing significant distress or dysfunction.
options.C: the behavior is a part of the individual's cultural or religious practices.
options.D: an alternative behavior cannot be identified.
options.E: a temporary increase in the behavior cannot be tolerated.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: E - a temporary increase in the behavior cannot be tolerated.
